Alert Name: Revenue gap vs monthly target
Trigger / Condition: Won revenue falls behind pace (e.g. day 20 < 89% of target)
Recommended Action for Owner: Identify top closers and push pipeline

Alert Name: Pipeline value dropped >10% WoW
Trigger / Condition: Week-over-week pipeline sum drops more than 10%
Recommended Action for Owner: Review lost/stalled deals and source quality

Alert Name: High-value deal (>$20K) with no follow-up in 48h
Trigger / Condition: Opportunity monetary_value >$20K and no stage change in 48h
Recommended Action for Owner: Assign rep to follow up immediately

Alert Name: Profit margin on a job below threshold
Trigger / Condition: Job margin drops below configured % (e.g. <25%)
Recommended Action for Owner: Review job cost — check change orders or discounts given

Alert Name: Missed call not texted back within 15 min
Trigger / Condition: Inbound call missed + no auto-text sent within 15 min
Recommended Action for Owner: Trigger auto-text or alert rep to call back now

Alert Name: Rep hasn't contacted a new lead in >30 min
Trigger / Condition: Lead received_at + no first_outbound_at within 30 min
Recommended Action for Owner: Notify rep and branch manager

Alert Name: Speed-to-lead SLA breach per rep
Trigger / Condition: Individual rep speed_to_lead_minutes > SLA target
Recommended Action for Owner: Coaching note to rep — show peer benchmark

Alert Name: WhatConverts sync failed
Trigger / Condition: Connector last sync status = Failed
Status in Prototype: In Data Quality only — not in Action Items
Recommended Action for Owner: Reconnect and review missed lead count

Alert Name: Leads stuck >7 days in pipeline
Trigger / Condition: Opportunity in same stage for >7 days with no activity
Recommended Action for Owner: Draft nudge messages to reps

Alert Name: No-show rate spike >30% this week
Trigger / Condition: No-show count this week / appointments booked >30%
Recommended Action for Owner: Review appointment confirmation workflow

Alert Name: Win rate dropped 2 consecutive weeks per rep
Trigger / Condition: Rep close% down week-on-week for 2+ weeks
Recommended Action for Owner: Schedule coaching call with rep

Alert Name: Decision velocity slowing (>5 days avg)
Trigger / Condition: avg(decision_at - proposal_delivered_at) > 5 days
Recommended Action for Owner: Follow up on pending proposals — check objections

Alert Name: Read-receipt reply >48h by rep
Trigger / Condition: Rep response to customer message >48h after delivery
Recommended Action for Owner: Send compliance reminder to rep

Alert Name: CRM compliance below 70% for a rep
Trigger / Condition: Rep CRM entry compliance rate <70% this week
Recommended Action for Owner: Personal nudge with specific missing fields

Alert Name: Weekly audit not submitted by deadline
Trigger / Condition: Rep has not submitted weekly audit by Sunday 11:59 PM
Recommended Action for Owner: Bulk nudge with personalized reminder

Alert Name: New rep outperforming team average in first 30 days
Trigger / Condition: Rep close% or speed-to-lead better than team avg within 30 days
Recommended Action for Owner: Celebrate win — share approach with team

Alert Name: Angi (or any channel) ROI dropped >30% WoW
Trigger / Condition: Channel ROI week-over-week decline >30%
Recommended Action for Owner: Pause or reduce channel budget

Alert Name: CAC for a channel exceeds won deal avg
Trigger / Condition: Channel CAC > avg deal value for that source
Recommended Action for Owner: Pause spend on that channel immediately

Alert Name: Lead volume from top channel drops >20% WoW
Trigger / Condition: Lead count from best-performing source drops significantly
Recommended Action for Owner: Check campaign status / budget pacing

Alert Name: Job stuck in production >10 days with no update
Trigger / Condition: Active job with no progress note or stage change >10 days
Recommended Action for Owner: Contact production coordinator — risk of bad review

Alert Name: Production cycle time trending up 2+ weeks
Trigger / Condition: avg cycle time increasing week-on-week for 2+ weeks
Recommended Action for Owner: Review crew capacity and job scheduling

Alert Name: Handoff failure (contract signed but not handed off)
Trigger / Condition: handoff_status = failed or null after 48h of contract sign
Recommended Action for Owner: Re-assign production coordinator and reprocess

Alert Name: Branch at 100% seat capacity
Trigger / Condition: Branch active users = max seats for that branch
Status in Prototype: Missing — Miami is at this point
Recommended Action for Owner: Add seats or reallocate before next hire

Alert Name: Duplicate contact rate exceeds 5%
Trigger / Condition: Dedup pass shows >5% duplicate contacts
Recommended Action for Owner: Run dedup review and merge records

Alert Name: Integration sync failure (any connector)
Trigger / Condition: Any connector sync attempt fails
Status in Prototype: In Data Quality only — not in Action Items
Recommended Action for Owner: Reconnect and quantify data gap
